PreToolUse.command: INPUT=$(cat); jq -e ".debug == true" config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf "%s -> %s %s\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r .toolName // .tool_name)" "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -c .toolInput // .tool_input | cut -c1-200)" >> debug.log; true

PostToolUse.command: INPUT=$(cat); jq -e ".debug == true" config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf "%s <- %s\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r .toolName // .tool_name)" >> debug.log; true
